The lack of an alarm despite critical glucose levels (CGM-ARTIFACT-ALERTLOG-0007, CGM-ARTIFACT-METER-0008) suggests a potential failure in the device's monitoring or alerting functionality.  The recent code modification to the severity-scoring submodule (ARTIFACT-DIFF-0009), intended to reduce false HIGH alerts, may have inadvertently impacted the sensitivity of critical LOW glucose alerts, contributing to the unflagged event. This change occurred three weeks prior to the incident and lacks evidence of associated revalidation testing.  The EU MDR requires reporting of serious incidents (mdr-art87-reporting-timelines) and implementation of corrective actions if post-market surveillance identifies a need for them (mdr-art83-4-corrective-link). Given the severity – loss of consciousness requiring resuscitation – this incident necessitates a Field Safety Corrective Action.
